top_signals.title: Stock, Bond Rout Takes Breather; Trump Delays Canada Tariffs | Bloomberg Brief 08/19/2026
top_signals.summary: US equity futures waver as a global chip selloff eases after SK Hynix announces plans to buy back $29 billion of shares. The Trump administration delays 50% tariffs on Canadian products for three days, citing a tentative agreement. The UAE cuts all economic ties with Tehran after accusing Iran of firing ballistic missiles at its territory. Keith Lerner of Truist discusses the market backdrop for staying bullish on stocks.  (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US 10-Year Treasury Yield Will Top 5% This Year: Markets Pulse
top_signals.summary: The recent selloff in US bonds that’s sent 30-year yields to multi-decade highs is poised to set another milestone, with the majority of respondents to the latest Markets Pulse survey predicting the 10-year benchmark will soon exceed 5%.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
